name: Lavr Kornilov

roles.title: Supreme Commander of the Russian Army

summary: A Siberian Cossack officer, an explorer of Turkestan and a military attache in Peking before the war, who escaped from Austrian captivity in 1916 and came out of it a public figure. Appointed Supreme Commander in the summer of 1917 to restore discipline, he sent a cavalry corps towards Petrograd in late August in circumstances that have been argued about ever since, was declared a rebel by the head of the government who had wanted the troops, and was arrested. He escaped to the Don, helped found the Volunteer Army, and was killed by a shell at Ekaterinodar in April 1918.
